SELECT 'store' k, CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) b, store_name c, city d, region e, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) f, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) g FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' OR city ILIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' OR store_id=102
UNION ALL

SELECT count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, sum(quantity) units, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

WITH u AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) n_versions, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku)
SELECT u.*, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand
FROM u JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=u.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') ctrl_units,
 (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') my_units,
 (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') returned_units

SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret_units_booked_in_period
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670)
GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY 1
